name: Dark Train: Coupe
source: Dark train: Coupe is a prequel to 2016 adventure game Dark Train. It is set in a coupe of a Train. Main story arc is played in the passenger train on the same railroad as in Dark Train. Player meets Ann Tagrezbung, protagonist from Dark Train. She is quite lovely, unmechanical and still human...
translation: 《黑暗列车：包厢》是2016年冒险游戏《黑暗列车》的前传。故事发生在一列火车的包厢里，主线在与《黑暗列车》相同的铁路客车上展开。玩家会遇见《黑暗列车》的主人公安·塔格雷兹邦。她美丽可爱，没有机械改造，依旧是人类……
